From far above, ONE narrow volumetric azure-blue (#0375DB) beam cuts straight down through the haze and lands on her raised right hand (on the left side of her body in the frame, held at chest height about 35 cm in front of her face): between her index and middle finger she has just CAUGHT one single card out of the storm, and that card blazes brilliant azure-white, the brightest thing in the frame, casting hard light up onto her face, her glasses and her right shoulder plate (on the left of the frame); her chest plate with the small isotype, turned away from the card, stays in soft shadow, white and never washed azure. Her whole right forearm is visible from elbow to fingertips; her left arm hangs relaxed at her side, its hand hidden below the console edge. The Research Spark is PERCHED ON HER LEFT SHOULDER (on the right side of the frame), its little hands resting on her shoulder plate, its LED eyes turned down toward the caught card, its magnifying glass held beside its own body and never in front of her face, lit softly from below by the card, sharp. It is the ONLY robot in the frame: no other Spark, drone or figure anywhere in the hangar. She wears the bionic suit exactly as in its reference, WITH the small navy Efeonce isotype inlaid on her chest plate exactly as in the reference and the macro (no other logo, no lettering), the bionic glasses exactly as in their reference, small gold earrings, NO watch, NO bracelet, NO ring. She looks straight into the lens through her clear glasses with calm conviction, both eyes and both eyebrows visible, razor-thin focus on her eyes. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm at f/1.8, her head about one quarter of the frame height, shoulders clearly wider than two head-widths. Her face stays well clear of the beam and of the caught card: the card sits below and to the left of her chin. GEOGRAPHY: the beam, the caught card, her hand, every falling card that catches any spill of light and the Spark stay inside the RIGHT 58% of the frame; the LEFT 42% of the frame is calm, dark, empty hangar space with only faint haze; at most a few far, dim, out-of-focus cards in its upper half and none in its lower half; no beam, no lit object, no bokeh light. The lower-left quarter of the frame stays the darkest, quietest area of the picture. Deep navy blacks, enormous contrast, awe-inspiring. No logos of any other brand, no readable text on any card.
